narrative.overview: Every Vorcove surface reads like the ledger from a business review: ruled sheets, heavy ink rules that close an account, column heads, tabular figures and totals that settle the argument. The system is typographic; imagery comes only from real product walkthroughs, framed and captioned as exhibits.
keyCharacteristics: Condensed uppercase Archivo headlines, wide tracked Archivo column heads, Public Sans text.
Tables, rows and rules instead of cards.
Beacon orange appears only on money.
One authored motion moment: ticking a fix in the sample ledger.

rules.name: The Palette Law
rules.body: Beacon orange (and its pen form) marks money and nothing else: recovered amounts, totals, leak markers. Buttons, links, tags and decoration never take it. The logo's beacon dot is the only exception.

rules.name: The Binding Rule
rules.body: Sea-ink full-width bands bind the ledger. Use them for the header, product exhibits, the review request and the footer, never as a card.

rules.name: The Column Head Rule
rules.body: Small uppercase labels exist only as column heads, captions and field labels. They never sit alone above a section heading.

rules.name: The Rule-Weight Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy between groups comes from rule weight (2px ink versus 1px hairline), never from shadows or cards.

dos: Do set every dollar figure in Archivo with tabular lining figures.
Do open and close every account (section) with a 2px ink rule.
Do label any demonstration figures as illustrative, right next to them.
Do use real product walkthroughs as the only imagery, captioned as exhibits.
donts: Don't use beacon orange for buttons, links, tags or decoration (the Palette Law).
Don't add shadows, cards or rounded corners above 4px.
Don't place a small uppercase label alone above a heading.
Don't add stock photography or decorative illustration.
Don't change the logo or its Bricolage wordmark.
